Hero_Desc_Beni:
A bear werebeast who is always easygoing and overenthusiastically scarfing down food.
She is so affable that she gets taken advantage of from time to time.
She is the lowest-ranking member of the Chow Rebels.
Album_Hate_Beni: Plastic bags filled with food. Her weight.
Album_Hobby_Beni: Playing board games she doesn't understand.
Album_Wish_Beni: Freely eating food without worrying about her future.
Album_Beni1: A tenacious werebeast warrior, once she trusts you, she remains loyal to the end. Her strength is immense, she is capable of lifting me with just one hand.
Album_Beni2: Although Beni seems to have no weakness in a fight, she does have one fatal flaw: A sweet tooth. It seems she often sneaks into the elven city or sprite village to steal such sweets as cakes and chocolates.
Album_Beni3: When other sprites travel with Beni, there seems to be a lot of awkward situations. Not only because of her fondness for sweets but also of her enormous appetite. Since sprites consume three days' worth of food in just one meal, this often causes friction with Erpin, the other cake monster.
Album_Beni4: Among all the sweet things, Beni's favorite is a soda with 'black sugar.' She once ventured into the elven city and became a model in an advertisement for this beverage... But I'm not sure if this is true.
Album_Beni5: Many assume because of Beni's incredible strength, she's rather simple minded, but that is surprisingly not the case. Of course, she's no genius, but at least she's not just some musclehead werebeast. She is, however... a little lazy...
Album_Beni6: Beni really gets along with Tig and Rufo, often play acting with them, but she seems to draw a line between acting and reality. The problem is, since she knows she's tenacious, she thinks won't be easily fooled, but that often leads Rufo to take advantage of her.
Album_Beni7: She also gets along well with Kommy because they share similar interests. Whenever she visits Kommy's house, there's always a pile of snacks. Since they're both the type to sleep a lot, they end up eating a bunch of sweets before passing out on the floor.
LoveHero_Beni:
Enticing someone without any food
is a no go.
You are going to feed me, aren't you?
LoveHeroCancel_Beni:
Oh no!
If you suddenly tell me to go,
who's gonna pay my food bills?!
Food_ChefNote_Beni_Hate1: Even Beni, who eats almost everything, has her limits. After taking a bite of this candy, she tried to hit me with her forepaw... I mean, her fists.
Food_ChefNote_Beni_Hate2: With a disappointed expression, Beni... said she probably would have liked it if the taste was sweet, refreshing, and bursting with carbonation.
Food_ChefNote_Beni_Like1:
Honey, salmon, and garlic... This food has everything Beni likes. 
As expected, she finished the meal with a happy smile on her face. Wait... Why does she like garlic?
Food_ChefNote_Beni_Like2: It was a very balanced and appropriate menu for Beni. The smile never left her face the entire time she was eating.
Food_ChefNote_Beni_Like3: As expected, Beni really enjoys it. Not surprising.
Food_ChefNote_Beni_Like4: She initially tried to pick out only those with honey, but soon gave up and ate any that were available.
Food_ChefNote_Beni_Like5: She expressed a desire to use it as a star ingredient in her cooking, asking for the recipe to be passed down.
Food_ChefNote_Beni_Like6: Beni said the taste was too good to enjoy alone. Eating with a smile, she wanted to bring some to her friends.
Food_ChefNote_Beni_Like7: I stopped Beni from eating it all in one bite and advised her to eat it slowly. Beni grumbled that she couldn't eat much if she ate it that way.
Food_ChefNote_Beni_Like8: If it were only sweet, I couldn't eat much, but the slight bitterness means I could eat endlessly. Beni explained with excitement.
Food_ChefNote_Beni_Like9: Beni swallowed several candies at once with a happy expression. I handed her a tissue in case she drooled.

LoveLetter_Beni: Hello there, Master! I hope I'm doing this right, hehe! When I said I wanted to thank you, Chief Diana suggested writing a letter. She's actually helping me write it right now! Uh... now she's telling me not to mention that. Anyway, thank you so much for always giving me delicious things to eat at the Banquet Hall and chatting with me. Next time you visit Werebeast Forest, I'll make something really delicious for you, okay?!
LoveCall_Beni:
Master, Master~! Um... Was my call too sudden? Hehe.
Actually... I took a nap today and dreamed about you!
In the dream, we ate piles of honey-glazed fish, cake, and macarons together, and then fell asleep... But when I woke up, it had all been a dream! Ah~ What a shame!

While I was feeling disappointed, I suddenly realized something.
At some point, you started appearing in my dreams often, Master!
Before that, I only dreamed about eating delicious food alone or playing together with Boss and Rufo... Strange, is it not? Hehe.
Maybe I think about you so much that you even appear in my dreams!

Thank you for listening, Master.
Next time, let us eat piles of delicious food together, just like in the dream! Hehe.
Affinity_Beni_EP01_001: Ah, I'm stuffed. I can't eat anymore.
Affinity_Beni_EP01_003: What do you mean, "finally"? Unlike a certain someone whose stomach is always empty, we werebeasts don't eat more once we're satisfied!
Affinity_Beni_EP01_005:
I'm not lying!
I've eaten my meal, so now I have to fill up on snacks, sweets, and desserts.
Affinity_Beni_EP01_006: You look too skinny. You should eat some more.
Affinity_Beni_EP01_007: Uh... Y-You think? Well... if you're offering, I won't decline!
Affinity_Beni_EP02_001: Hmm... what should I have for breakfast tomorrow? Bread with honey or apple pie...?
Affinity_Beni_EP02_003:
I, too, have my likes and dislikes, okay?
I may eat everything with no problem, but I do have my favorites!
Affinity_Beni_EP02_005: Mhmm! Anything with honey is the best, right? Okay, I've decided!
Affinity_Beni_EP02_007: A pie with crunchy apples isn't bad either. It's not a bad breakfast.
Affinity_Beni_EP03_001: Tch, everyone thinks I'm a fool! I use my brain too when I need to!
Affinity_Beni_EP03_002: Who looked down on you? I'll give them a good scolding.
Affinity_Beni_EP03_003: Huh? N-No, please don't do that! I don't want my friends to get scolded.
Affinity_Beni_EP03_004: Yeah. Bears are definitely considered "smart" animals.
Affinity_Beni_EP03_005: That's what I'm saying! Wait... why do you say it like that? Are you making fun of me?
Affinity_Beni_EP03_006: Don't get yourself down. One day, they will realize what you're capable of.
Affinity_Beni_EP03_007: Kay! Yes, that day will come. One day... um...
Affinity_Beni_EP04_001: The chief has been working me hard recently. Sigh... I just want some time to play.
Affinity_Beni_EP04_002: Seems you're as busy as a bear.
Affinity_Beni_EP04_004: Why not run away once in a while?
Affinity_Beni_EP04_005: Run away? From the chief? Yikes... I don't even wanna think about it.
Affinity_Beni_EP04_006: But doesn't she reward you when you're done? Just focus on that.
Affinity_Beni_EP04_007:
Oh yeah, the chief gives me a bag full of delicious food when I'm done!
Hehe, just the thought of it makes me smile!
Affinity_Beni_EP05_001: Why am I never full no matter how much air I breathe in?
Affinity_Beni_EP05_002: That's how air works, yes. *Nods silently*
Affinity_Beni_EP05_004: Are the denizens of Elias even aware of the existence of air?
Affinity_Beni_EP05_005: Geez...! Are you really gonna patronize us like that?!
Affinity_Beni_EP05_006: Stop trying to get full on air, just ask for more food.
Affinity_Beni_EP05_007: Really? I can have more? Hehe! Thank you!
Affinity_Beni_EP06_001:
There was a time when I made soup out of whatever I could find in the trash cans of the elven city.
I miss that taste sometimes.
Affinity_Beni_EP06_002: Uh, thanks but no thanks. Please keep that memory to yourself.
Affinity_Beni_EP06_003: It wasn't that bad! Elves often throw things away without even opening the packaging, you know...
Affinity_Beni_EP06_004: I... uh, can put that on the menu if you want, I guess.
Affinity_Beni_EP06_005: Really? Um... no, it's okay. I'll leave it in the past as a fond memory.
Affinity_Beni_EP06_006: Did you share it with your werebeast friends?
Affinity_Beni_EP06_007: As if I'd share something that delicious with my friends! I ate it all by myself.
Affinity_Beni_EP07_001: I think the chief is a bit too much sometimes. She punishes us for every little mistake we make!
Affinity_Beni_EP07_003: Are you saying it's all my fault? You're mean!
Affinity_Beni_EP07_004: What mischief did you get into with your friends today?
Affinity_Beni_EP07_005: How did you know? Are you a psychic?
Affinity_Beni_EP07_006: Excessive punishment isn't good. What kind of punishment did you get?
Affinity_Beni_EP07_007: Cleaning my room...? Why are you suddenly making that face?
Affinity_Beni_EP08_001:
I guess it's popular among sprites to put on perfume.
I don't know why everyone disguises themselves with delicious smells.
Affinity_Beni_EP08_002: It's not perfume, it's just the smell of sugar.
Affinity_Beni_EP08_003: The smell of sugar? How much sugar do you have to eat to actually smell like it?
Affinity_Beni_EP08_004: I think you'd better spray some on you, too.

Affinity_Beni_EP08_006: I love the smell of baked goods. It's comforting.
Affinity_Beni_EP08_007:
I drool when I get close to sprites.
They look at me in a scary way, but so what?
Affinity_Beni_EP09_001: Why does everyone think I'm lazy?
Affinity_Beni_EP09_002: Well, bears have this chubby and laid-back look.
Affinity_Beni_EP09_003:
But that's not how bears are in real life! They're fast, muscular, and ferocious!
Ah, I'm not quite like that, though.
Affinity_Beni_EP09_004: Probably because they haven't seen true laziness.
Affinity_Beni_EP09_005: Really? Does being lazy also take commitment?
Affinity_Beni_EP09_006: Probably because it's true that you're lazy.
Affinity_Beni_EP09_007: What? Do you also think of me that way, Master? I'm shocked!
Affinity_Beni_EP10_001: Master! What's today's snack? I'm starving!
Affinity_Beni_EP10_005: Are you sure this is edible? Mmm... Aaaah! It's blowing up! But it also tastes sweet, ahaha!
Affinity_Beni_EP10_006: The snack corner closed early due to Erpin.
Affinity_Beni_EP10_007: She ate everything by herself? That's amazing! B-But now I have nothing to eat! I'm so sad...
Affinity_Beni_EP11_001: Ah, I'm so full! Master, can I take a quick nap here?
Affinity_Beni_EP11_002: You can't sleep in the Banquet Hall.
Affinity_Beni_EP11_003: Huh? Aren't you supposed to let people nap after they eat?
Affinity_Beni_EP11_005: Wow, really? Then, can you make some snacks for me to eat when I wake up?
Affinity_Beni_EP11_006: Why don't you just go back and sleep?
Affinity_Beni_EP11_007: Recently, if you take a nap in the village, the Chief scolds you for being lazy.
Affinity_Beni_EP12_001: That's strange... I definitely smell something sweet somewhere....
Affinity_Beni_EP12_002: I think your nose is broken.
Affinity_Beni_EP12_003: Really? There's no way my nose is wrong....
Affinity_Beni_EP12_005: Oh, was she carrying something delicious? ...Oh, or maybe she stopped by the bakery?
Affinity_Beni_EP12_006: I had some cream on me from Ashur's Bakery earlier... Could that be it?
Affinity_Beni_EP12_007: I found the culprit! Quick, give me some of that cream!
Affinity_Beni_EP13_001: Master, do you want to go honey collecting with me next time?

Affinity_Beni_EP13_004: Hard work is such a hassle.
Affinity_Beni_EP13_005: Of course you don't want to do the boring stuff! But without honey, I can't make fish taste delicious!
Affinity_Beni_EP13_006: Why don't you use sugar instead of honey?

Affinity_Beni_EP14_001: What do you usually do in your free time, Master?
Affinity_Beni_EP14_003: Oh, me too! Since we're talking about it, do you want to have some snacks?
Affinity_Beni_EP14_005: Ugh, that sounds like it would make my brain hurt. Isn't there anything else?

Affinity_Beni_EP15_001: Master! Is there anything I can help you with?

Affinity_Beni_EP16_005: That sounds delicious, too! Ah... I want some fish. Would you like to go fishing, Master?

Affinity_Beni_EP19_001: Are there any leftover ingredients in the Banquet Hall?

Affinity_Beni_EP20_006: I guess they include air as a side dish.
Affinity_Beni_EP20_007: Even so, I won't fall for that! Air doesn't taste like anything no matter how you serve it!
